fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary on the Wolfarth administration and City Hall, discussion of proposed changes affecting water rates and taxation, and reporting on a sharp drop in anticipated profits at Burdine's with reduced Christmas bonuses for employees. Coverage also addresses Miami Beach hotel operators seeking a return to a more "liberal policy" to support tourism, enforcement of an anti-cigarette ordinance, and court reporting including a prostitution-related case. Additional items include seasonal travel and hotel-rate trends, dog racing attendance, Florida Highway Patrol holiday safety warnings, and entertainment/nightlife listings and advertisements.
